sources.title: Attorney General’s Chambers, Brunei Darussalam: Brief History
sources.note: Indexed original full text checked: nineteenth-century contraction, 1888 protectorate, 1906 Resident, 1959 constitution, 1971 revision and 1 January 1984 independence. Direct page fetch failed. Avoid broad claim of direct rule over all Borneo.

sources.title: Annabel Teh Gallop, Silsilah Raja-Raja Brunei: The Manuscript of Pengiran Kesuma Muhammad Hasyim, Archipel 97 (2019), pp173 to 212
sources.note: Full article read through author’s ResearchGate mirror at https://www.researchgate.net/publication/333777031_Silsilah_Raja-Raja_Brunei_The_Manuscript_of_Pengiran_Kesuma_Muhammad_Hasyim . Publisher page has bot barrier. Printed pp176,178 to 180,187 to 188,190,195,201 to 202. Introduction p178 has inilah; critical transcription p190 has ini. Sample deliberately follows p178 quotation and its adjacent translation, not a reconstructed Jawi rendering. All mirrors one work.

sources.title: Michel L’Hour, Brunei (Borneo), French Ministry of Culture maritime archaeology
sources.note: Late-fifteenth-century wreck, 1997 survey, excavation from May1998, 65m depth and catalogue of about14,000 significant objects. French and English versions are one work.

sources.title: Annabel Teh Gallop, Warkah Brunei, Malay Concordance Project, Australian National University
sources.note: Indexed original complete bibliography and letter summaries checked. Gallop1995 critical edition pp207 to 235, list pp217 to 218. Letters2/15: BL Add12398 ff30v to 31r; LC MS Jawi12 f[2K]. Contemporary letters are voices of court and Singapore officials, not a household census. Direct fetch failed.

sources.title: Ministry of Education, The National Education System for the 21st Century: SPN21 (2013)
sources.note: Indexed original printed p6 sections2.1 to 2.2 checked; direct PDF timeout. Malay edition corroborates but is same work. Dates concern modern school institutions, not first learning in Brunei.

sources.title: Information Department, Brunei Today, September 2014, Kampong Ayer Upgrading Pilot Project
sources.note: Indexed original printed p4 checked. Reproducible query: "Brunei Today sept2014" sewerage treatment plants. Project completed10July2012, bridges, treatment, pumps, concrete columns/floors and flame-retardant wooden walls. Direct PDF timeout.

sources.title: Brunei Tourism, Local Delicacies
sources.note: Ambuyat and Kelupis sections, directly read. Contemporary culinary descriptions and Bisaya wedding association. Does not date recipes to1650; no claim all Bruneians eat identically.

sources.title: Brunei Shell Petroleum, Community Development: Billionth Barrel Monument
sources.note: Heritage section: monument1991 near S-1, first commercial oil1929. Company is primary custodian of its industrial heritage; present production statistics omitted.

sources.title: Peter Stanley, Borneo 1942 to 1945, Australian Department of Veterans’ Affairs (2007)
sources.note: Oboe6 section:10June1945 landings, liberation of Brunei town and Seria, engineers extinguishing oil wells and restoring roads/bridges. General introduction’s overbroad earlier Brunei territorial statement not used.

sources.title: National Army Museum, Indonesian Confrontation: Brunei revolt
sources.note: Brunei revolt section,8December1962 uprising and British intervention. Museum military framing acknowledged; no unsupported assertion that all rebels shared one motivation.

sources.title: Ministry of Defence, Brunei Darussalam: Introduction
sources.note: Official account of1January1984 independence and assumption of defence responsibilities. Supports continuing sovereign state, not a terminal fall date.

proposedOverrides.name: Brunei
proposedOverrides.summary: A Bornean sultanate transformed by territorial contraction, British protection and restored independence.

batchIdentityNotes.decision: One continuing indexed state with explicitly differentiated sovereignty phases. No other similarly named indexed record, existing card or curated transition found. Do not expand coverage to Sabah/Sarawak or merge other Bornean peoples.
batchIdentityNotes.geometry: Decoded18 TopoJSON intervals1650 to 2020 all repeat bbox114.07254,3.99820 to115.15975,5.01598. ModernGeoJSON2020 to 2100 bbox114.204,4.008 to115.451,5.448 differs. Public overview warns of static historical outline and modern seam. No boundary correction attempted.
batchIdentityNotes.dating: Map1650 to null is coverage, not founding or extinction. Late15c shipwreck is explicitly earlier background; early19c manuscript is not a17c autograph;2012 sanitation and present food are explicitly later.
